sources.label: Horizon Nexus (Audit) AUDF Reserves Report: August 2026

reserveReview.rationale: Reviewed 2026-09-21. Forte's current transparency page states that AUDF is fully backed 1:1 by Australian dollar reserves held with regulated financial institutions. Horizon Nexus (Audit) Pty Ltd audited the complete AUDF reserve bank-account cash balance of AUD 5,142,851.53 as of 31 August 2026 and issued an unmodified opinion dated 7 September 2026 under Australian Auditing Standards. The report supports one 100% AUD bank-deposit slice. It does not identify the bank or reconcile token liabilities inside the audit engagement, so those matters remain custody and assurance limitations rather than unidentified reserve assets. Rechecked 2026-09-29 for the pre-expiry sweep: the issuer documents endpoint still serves audf-reserves-report-august-2026 as the newest monthly reserve audit, the September and October 2026 slugs return 404, monthly slugs resolve continuously from February through August 2026, and the legacy Squarespace PDF paths are dead after the site migration, so no newer primary evidence exists and compositionAsOf stays 2026-08-31. The August report was signed on 7 September 2026, so the September 2026 report covering September 30, 2026 balances is expected around the first week of October 2026; until it is published, this curated composition stops being admitted for Safety Score V9 when the 31-day composition window plus 7-day reporting grace ends on 2026-10-08.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Horizon Nexus independent audit of the AUDF reserve bank-account cash balance as of 2026-08-31
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The complete reserve asset class is identified as an AUD reserve bank-account cash balance. The bank identity, provider concentration, account terms, and audit-level token-liability reconciliation remain undisclosed.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: The May 2026 reserve report described one segregated, unencumbered AUDF reserve account in Australia without naming the bank. The August 31 report audits AUD 5,142,851.53 cash assets but does not establish holder trust/title, successor-custody continuity, or token-liability reconciliation. Source recovery on 2026-10-21 found the current issuer-linked terms and PDS through the rendered Legal & Regulatory directory: the obsolete January-2026-named /s/ URL returning HTTP 404 is link migration, not evidence of issuer non-disclosure. The retrieved terms are dated 15 January 2025 v4.0; clauses 1(g)-(i), 4.1(c) and 17(c) give only a contingent contractual redemption claim, deny a trust/fiduciary relationship and disclaim custody warranties. The issuer's 30 June 2026 PDS, pages 5 and 7, independently states no trust/proprietary reserve interest, unsecured-creditor insolvency status and no reserve security interest. These adverse legal terms support retaining the absence of bankruptcy-remoteness credit independently of the obsolete URL and of the distributor PDS. Bank identity, provider allocations, anti-rehypothecation and successor-custody arrangements remain undisclosed on the retrieved issuer terms, issuer PDS, transparency and reserve audit surfaces. The issuer's regulated-financial-institutions statement does not identify the bank or independently close all material custody layers. No custodian is asserted to be unregulated. Existing provider identity, historical segregation observation and original review dates remain unchanged.
